entries.name: 01-caixa
entries.prompt: Use case: game obstacle visual redesign, soft-3D mobile puzzle sprite. Image 1 is the element identity reference; Image 2 is the APPROVED CABINET and is the authoritative material, lighting and finish reference. Redesign ONLY the element in image 1 to convincingly belong to the same visual family as that cabinet: simplified sculpted rounded forms, soft broad bevels, subtle ambient occlusion in joins, broad diffused upper-left key light, quiet fill light, believable material volume. Replace dark drawn outlines and graphic inner strokes with material transitions and gentle contact shadows. Thin gentle edges, no black/brown ink contours, no harsh white streaks, no realistic noisy grain, no excessive decorative details. This is polished cartoon 3D, not photorealistic, not flat vector, not a line drawing. Keep original recognizability and colors; the cabinet is a FINISH reference, do not turn the subject into a wooden cupboard and do not copy its doors. Front-facing game-board view with a small amount of top depth, centered whole single object on a genuinely transparent background, no ground plane, no backdrop, no external cast shadow, no text, no labels, no sheet, no duplicate views. Leave 8 percent transparent margin. Subject: one compact square honey-wood crate, closed, with two removable wooden reinforcement planks crossing in an X on its front and four SMALL muted blue round bolt heads. Retain this construction and full resistance state. Use the cabinet's warm softly shaded wood surface, simplified fine joins rather than black seams, thin rounded outer frame, restrained satin blue bolt highlights. No woodgrain lines or extra nails; give the X planks visible thickness through soft light and occlusion. Make it feel like a solid little 3D toy crate, not a thick outlined drawing.
